title: fln configuration
description: Configuration file for fln — flatten your codebase into a single file for LLMs

output.description: Output file path or directory. Default: auto-generated from project metadata (e.g. my-app-1.0.0.md)

overwrite.description: Overwrite output file instead of adding numeric suffix when it already exists

includePatterns.description: Glob patterns to force include, overriding .gitignore rules

includeHidden.description: Include hidden files and directories (starting with .)

maxTotalSize.description: Maximum total size for all included files. 0 means unlimited

ansi.description: Use ANSI colors in log output

date.description: Fixed date string for the Generated header (overrides current date). Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm

banner.description: Custom text prepended to output after the header

bannerFile.description: Path to file whose contents are prepended to output (relative to input directory). File is excluded from tree

footer.description: Custom text appended to the end of output

footerFile.description: Path to file whose contents are appended to output (relative to input directory). File is excluded from tree
